title: Harbor on‑Prem weekly playback notes (prep + followups)
content:
Meeting: Harbor (customer) — On‑prem/VPC weekly sync (prep + quick playback)
Date: 2026-03-13
Owner: Ellen Park (SE lead)
Attendees (planned): Samir (network), Noah (infra), Priya (SRE), Customer: DevOps lead (Marta), Platform eng (Rui)

Purpose: quick alignment before Thursday customer sync. Capture blockers, short term milestones, owners and clear next actions. This is a personal scratchpad — will tidy and push the action list to Confluence after the call.

PRE-READ / CONTEXT
- Current state: cluster provisioned in customer VPC, private control plane connected via VPN, base images loaded to private registry. Helm chart applied in staging namespace. Initial inference pods starting but OOMs under load test.
- Goal for next customer sync: present mitigation plan for OOM + ETA for canary rollout, confirm KMS key rotation plan and firewall rule list for final install.
- Risk: if OOM persists we delay canary by 1 week and fallback to hosted API for critical routes.

AGENDA (my draft)
1) Quick status (2m) — Ellen
2) Network & infra blockers (5m) — Samir / Marta
3) Runtime stability: OOM analysis + mitigation (10m) — Noah
4) Security: KMS/HSM integration and audit logs (5m) — Priya
5) Rollout plan & dates: canary criteria, rollback conditions (7m) — Ellen + Rui
6) Actions & owners (3m)

NOTES / POINTS TO MAKE (short bullets for the call)
- OOMs spike at ~30 concurrent requests; appears correlated with sequence length distribution & lack of kv-cache warmup.
- Short-term mitigations: reduce max_concurrency to 16, enable prefix-cache for chat prompts, enforce token cap 1024 for initial canary.
- Long-term: we recommend quantized model build (4-bit) + memory-optimized kernel selection — takes ~4 business days to validate.
- KMS: customer wants HSM-backed keys; our Private control plane supports HSM via KMIP connector, need their HSM endpoint + ACLs.
- Network: need egress allowance to our artifact mirror (artifacts.redwood.corp:443) and inbound ephemeral port range 30000-32767 for nodePort health checks (or we can switch to LoadBalancer via LBaaS).

MILESTONES & CURRENT STATUS
- M1: Cluster provisioned (done 2026-03-05) — owner: Marta (customer) — status: done
- M2: Private registry sync and image signing (done 2026-03-09) — owner: Rui — status: done
- M3: Helm deploy to staging + smoke (2026-03-11) — owner: Noah — status: partial (pods crash/oom)
- M4: Stability mitigation + tuned helm values (target 2026-03-16) — owner: Ellen/Noah — status: in_progress
- M5: Canary rollout (target 2026-03-19) — owner: Ellen/Priya — status: blocked (OOM)

BLOCKERS (explicit)
1) Pod OOMs under synthetic load — observed memory usage ~22Gi on an 16Gi node (suspect double-counting due to unbounded kv cache + model weights not quantized).
   - Evidence: kubelet logs, jmap, inference logs (OOMKill), heap profiles attached in PR-91.
   - Workarounds: reduce model batch size, enable kv cache TTL, restart policy change (not ideal).
   - Owner: Noah. ETA for triage: 48h (by 2026-03-15).
2) KMS/HSM integration details outstanding — customer hasn't provided KMIP endpoint & allowed CAs.
   - Risk: prevents production secret rotation verification and audit readiness.
   - Owner: Marta (customer) + Priya for Redwood side. Target to get creds by 2026-03-16.
3) Firewall/proxy egress rule required for artifact mirror access — customer security team concerned about outbound to external registries.
   - Proposal: use our mirror hosted in their org (we can push images to their S3/registry) or open egress to artifacts.redwood.corp with mutual TLS.
   - Owner: Samir (network) + Customer Sec (Marta).
4) Telemetry ingestion: Prometheus push gateway needs access; currently blocked by strict network ACLs.
   - Owner: Priya. Quick fix: run a sidecar that posts metrics via customer-approved proxy.

ACTION ITEMS (clean list to send to customer after call)
- AI-01: Noah — complete OOM triage, attach memory flame graphs and proposed helm tuning (values.yaml) — due 2026-03-15 — status: open
- AI-02: Customer (Marta) — share KMIP endpoint + CA bundle, and contact for HSM admin — due 2026-03-16 — status: open
- AI-03: Samir + Customer Sec — confirm egress approach (open egress vs local mirror) and make decision — due 2026-03-16 — status: open
- AI-04: Priya — prepare short runbook for telemetry sidecar option and checklist for Prometheus->Observability integration — due 2026-03-17 — status: open
- AI-05: Ellen — draft canary criteria doc (latency p95 < 250ms, token cost delta < 10%, error rate < 0.5%) and post to Confluence — due 2026-03-15 — status: open

QUESTIONS TO ASK CUSTOMER (during sync)
- Can you confirm expected peak concurrent sessions for the canary bucket? Need a realistic load target.
- Do you have an existing HSM onboarding window (maintenance window) next week?
- Are security okay with temporary egress to artifacts.redwood.corp if we use mTLS and IP allowlist?

RISK MATRIX (quick)
- High: OOM -> delays canary (mitigation: block-level resource limits + quantized build)
- Medium: KMS delay -> audit hold (mitigation: manual key import + temp usage policy)
- Low: Telemetry gaps -> reduced observability (mitigation: sidecar proxy)

NOTES TO SELF / AD HOC IDEAS
- Consider shipping a trimmed model variant for the canary (drop unnecessary heads) to reduce mem footprint temporarily; discuss with Applied ML if feasible in 48h.
- If customer insists on no egress, offer to drive a quick S3 registry sync automation (we push signed images to their S3) — ask infra for estimated time.
- Keep hosted fallback plan concise in slide: what routes degrade to hosted, how to handle keys and data residency during fallback.

FOLLOWUP / COMMUNICATION PLAN
- Send cleaned action list + ETA doc to Marta and internal leads within 24h after call.
- Attach PR-91 logs and flame graphs to the Confluence page for traceability.
- Schedule 30m deep dive with Applied ML (noah + rui + aml eng) if OOM not resolved in 48h.

MEETING PREP CHECKLIST (quick tickbox in my head)
- [ ] Attach flame graphs to notes (done: estimated)
- [ ] Confirm attendees and time zones (Ellen)
- [ ] Prepare 1-slide summary for canary criteria (Ellen)
- [ ] Make sure Priya has audit/KMS talking points (Priya)

END OF SCRATCHPAD — will convert to pretty action list and upload to Confluence after sync.
